name: composting-system
description:
Designs a home composting system covering bin, pile, and tumbler options with brown-to-green ratios (25-30:1 carbon to nitrogen), turning schedules, and troubleshooting for common problems like odor and slow decomposition. Produces a composting plan with material lists and maintenance schedule.
Use when the user asks about starting composting, choosing a compost method, what can be composted, compost ratios, or troubleshooting a compost pile.
Do NOT use for commercial-scale composting, vermicomposting (worm bin) specifics, or municipal composting programs.
